statement_texts: SELECT station.id AS station_id, station.agency AS station_agency, station.external_id AS station_external_id, station.name AS station_name, station.basin_id AS station_basin_id, station.lon AS station_lon, station.lat AS station_lat, station.vertical_datum AS station_vertical_datum, station.time_zone AS station_time_zone FROM station WHERE station.id = ?

SELECT forecast_run.id, forecast_run.product_id, forecast_run.fp_id, forecast_run.issued_at, forecast_run.retrieved_at, forecast_run.available_at, forecast_run.issuer, forecast_run.primary_variable, forecast_run.unit, forecast_run.stage_unit, forecast_run.flow_unit, forecast_run.datum, forecast_run.raw_artifact_id, forecast_run.supersedes_run_id FROM forecast_run WHERE forecast_run.fp_id = ? AND forecast_run.available_at <= ? AND forecast_run.product_id IN (?, ?, ?) ORDER BY forecast_run.issued_at DESC, forecast_run.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT forecast_value.id, forecast_value.run_id, forecast_value.valid_time, forecast_value.stage, forecast_value.flow FROM forecast_value WHERE forecast_value.run_id = ? ORDER BY forecast_value.valid_time

SELECT basin.id, basin.name, basin.regulation_class, basin.outlet_fp_id, basin.huc8, basin.centroid, basin.bbox, basin.geometry_ref, basin.regulated_by, basin.susceptibility_gauge_id, basin.susceptibility_confidence_ceiling, basin.susceptibility_note FROM basin ORDER BY basin.id
SELECT source_product.id, source_product.source_id, source_product.label, source_product.variables, source_product.expected_cadence_seconds, source_product.grace_seconds FROM source_product

SELECT forecast_point.id, forecast_point.lid, forecast_point.name, forecast_point.station_id, forecast_point.basin_id, forecast_point.upstream_lids, forecast_point.downstream_lids, forecast_point.reach_id, forecast_point.datums, forecast_point.rfc, forecast_point.wfo, forecast_point.in_service, forecast_point.lon, forecast_point.lat FROM forecast_point WHERE forecast_point.lid = ?

SELECT threshold.id, threshold.fp_id, threshold.product_id, threshold.category, threshold.value, threshold.unit, threshold.basis, threshold.datum, threshold.source_kind, threshold.effective_from, threshold.retrieved_at, threshold.raw_artifact_id FROM threshold WHERE threshold.fp_id = ? AND threshold.effective_from <= ? ORDER BY threshold.effective_from, threshold.id

SELECT observation.id, observation.station_id, observation.product_id, observation.variable, observation.value, observation.unit, observation.datum, observation.valid_time, observation.retrieved_at, observation.available_at, observation.quality, observation.qualifier_raw, observation.revision_of, observation.revision_seq, observation.raw_artifact_id FROM observation WHERE observation.station_id = ? AND observation.variable = ? AND observation.available_at <= ? AND observation.valid_time >= ? AND observation.valid_time <= ? ORDER BY observation.valid_time, observation.revision_seq

SELECT forecast_run.id, forecast_run.product_id, forecast_run.fp_id, forecast_run.issued_at, forecast_run.retrieved_at, forecast_run.available_at, forecast_run.issuer, forecast_run.primary_variable, forecast_run.unit, forecast_run.stage_unit, forecast_run.flow_unit, forecast_run.datum, forecast_run.raw_artifact_id, forecast_run.supersedes_run_id FROM forecast_run WHERE forecast_run.fp_id = ? AND forecast_run.available_at <= ? AND forecast_run.product_id IN (?) ORDER BY forecast_run.issued_at DESC, forecast_run.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT derived_feature.id, derived_feature.feature, derived_feature.scope_kind, derived_feature.scope_id, derived_feature.window, derived_feature.valid_time, derived_feature.issued_at, derived_feature.computed_at, derived_feature.available_at, derived_feature.method_id, derived_feature.product_id, derived_feature.value, derived_feature.values_json, derived_feature.unit, derived_feature.percentile, derived_feature.climatology_ref, derived_feature.confidence_label, derived_feature.quality, derived_feature.inputs, derived_feature.raw_inputs_hash, derived_feature.raw_artifact_id FROM derived_feature WHERE derived_feature.feature = ? AND derived_feature.scope_id = ? AND derived_feature.available_at <= ? AND derived_feature.method_id = ? AND derived_feature.valid_time >= ? AND derived_feature.valid_time <= ? ORDER BY derived_feature.valid_time, derived_feature.available_at, derived_feature.id

SELECT derived_feature.id, derived_feature.feature, derived_feature.scope_kind, derived_feature.scope_id, derived_feature.window, derived_feature.valid_time, derived_feature.issued_at, derived_feature.computed_at, derived_feature.available_at, derived_feature.method_id, derived_feature.product_id, derived_feature.value, derived_feature.values_json, derived_feature.unit, derived_feature.percentile, derived_feature.climatology_ref, derived_feature.confidence_label, derived_feature.quality, derived_feature.inputs, derived_feature.raw_inputs_hash, derived_feature.raw_artifact_id FROM derived_feature WHERE derived_feature.feature = ? AND derived_feature.scope_id = ? AND derived_feature.available_at <= ? AND derived_feature.method_id = ? AND derived_feature.window = ? AND derived_feature.valid_time >= ? ORDER BY derived_feature.valid_time, derived_feature.available_at, derived_feature.id
